classes.purpose: Establish source roles, reporting perimeter, exact columns, accounting categories, signs, periods, controls, and the reviewed recipe before calculation
classes.content: User instructions; supplied export and sheet names; every source column name and observed type; table row counts; and at most the first 10 rows of each table, with cell text bounded to 200 characters. The complete supplied CSV, Excel, or ZIP population is read locally to inventory the tables. Source roles, account meaning, customer identity, and signs are selected through model-led and professional review rather than filename rules. Vera performs no automatic anonymization or pseudonymization. The reviewed recipe also declares the report audience and the source basis/assumptions for remaining-month forecast estimates.

classes.purpose: Interpret the exact management pack and identify observations, hypotheses, questions, missing evidence, and limitations
classes.content: A bounded model_context.json containing calculated metrics, coverage and control statuses, calculated section rows capped at 60 per section (including monthly series and service profitability), top-party lists capped at 20, and customer rows additionally limited by the reviewed top-customer setting (1 to 50), source IDs and hashes, and limitations. Local code rebuilds this projection from the complete calculated pack and writes a hash-bound validation receipt; the complete pack is not a separate default model input. Raw source populations, absolute paths, and original filenames are excluded from this post-calculation projection by default. Budget comparison rows are separately capped at 60, with the full row count disclosed. All calculation metric IDs remain available. Full report HTML contains all views; the cap applies to the default model projection only. For focused costing, the bounded projection contains the question, requested methods, synthetic-data flag, calculated margins and decision deltas, controls, limitations and up to 60 calculated rows per section with the full costing row count. The complete costing_workpapers, cost-row labels and evidence locators are excluded from that post-calculation projection. All calculation metric IDs remain available.

classes.purpose: Prepare a metric-linked professional-review draft without changing calculated facts
classes.content: The bounded calculated context plus draft observations and hypotheses tied to exact metric IDs, management questions, and limitations. The deterministic finalizer checks pack identity, rejects a blocked pack or failed declared control, and validates commentary schema and metric-reference closure; business causation, accounting correctness, completeness, materiality, and professional approval remain model-led or professional judgments.

classes.purpose: Consult relevant studio procedures, precedents or case evidence when requested
classes.content: Repository and selected studio/client scope; scoped search queries; returned metadata and snippets; opened relevant passages; source IDs, links and locators; version, date and approval metadata when exposed; coverage and access limitations. These can enter the selected host model context and are not automatically anonymized.

classes.purpose: Qualify costing objects, consumed costs, classifications, drivers and incremental assumptions
classes.content: The selected source records, recorded statements and estimates, evidence locators and hashes, the business question, period and perimeter, cost-object labels, exact revenue and cost amounts, proposed fixed/variable and direct/indirect classifications, driver weights and capacity assumptions, reviewed independent source totals, mapping notes and reviewer identity. The model authors the prepared case from these records; local calculation does not erase prior model exposure. No automatic anonymization occurs.

classes.purpose: Interpret one exact sealed normal calculation and an explicitly selected complete commentary proposal when the optional maintained panel is available
classes.content: Explicit current source MCP context returns the whole existing bounded model_context.json, actual execution/context receipts, normal commentary template and public specialist method reference. Commentary context optionally includes the expressly chosen complete literal normal commentary. It excludes raw source populations, the complete pack and private unsent intake/named readback by default; prior source/case-preparation model exposure remains unchanged. App metadata holds exact input choices, complete registered recipe/case, output paths, full commentary and declared name/time/basis. Model staging receives the complete authored commentary; public validation checks schema, exact pack and metric references, not prose quality or causation. No automatic model worker is invoked and actual reads must be recorded separately in the ordinary run-level report. Shared native integration remains incomplete for initial source/case preparation and interactive HTML opening; these use the complete ordinary specialist path. Real installed-host handoff has not yet been qualified.

classes.purpose: Prepare a whole reporting recipe or costing case under a distinct explicit source mandate
classes.content: After renewed explicit saved source/question confirmation, author context contains literal question and reporting/costing path, receipt IDs, exact SHA hashes and authorized absolute original-file paths, therefore original/client-folder names where present. An optional explicitly selected prior complete-case path can expose its data and declared reviews if actually read. Authorized originals may contain full transactions, parties, costs and evidence; their mandate is not proof of model reads. Public reporting inspection is a bounded sample, not the population; focused costing has no ledger requirement. The explicitly selected whole proposal is a bound file path plus open-items note, and model staging receives the whole ordinary payload. Private unsent decision/name/time/basis stays excluded from author context; app metadata can show whole proposed/prior cases and named drafts. No provider worker starts; actual model exposure needs the ordinary run-level report. Source registration/closure currently have missing capability wiring defects; the verified correction is unapplied. Installed host/model acceptance and native report opening remain pending.

external_boundaries.destination: OpenAI Sites through the selected host Sites connector
external_boundaries.purpose: Publish the reviewed budget and forecast report for the selected readers
external_boundaries.content: The host uploads the complete rendered HTML: entity, all compiled financial comparisons including hidden views, forecast basis, coverage and limitations, metric-linked commentary and optional customer, supplier and service labels. Raw export populations, original files, local paths and the full pack JSON are not copied into dist. The local preparation helper makes no network request. Sites manages hosting and visitor access; retention and deletion are not enforced by the plugin.
controls: An explicit Sites publication request selects this route; host-required action approvals still apply. Invitations need authorized recipients.
Source replay must equal the persisted pack. The audience must match the reviewed recipe. Blocked or unsupported budget reports cannot be prepared. A fresh output folder preserves prior versions.
All compiled HTML views remain delivered; selection controls do not redact hidden values. No automatic anonymization occurs.
Verify deployment and visitor access. Refresh requires new source review and explicit publication using the existing Site ID.

external_boundaries.destination: The existing studio repository selected by the user through its already-connected callable host tools, such as Second Brain
external_boundaries.purpose: Search and read relevant studio knowledge for the selected Vera workflow
external_boundaries.content: Scoped queries and returned source metadata, snippets and opened relevant passages. The repository receives the connector requests; returned evidence may enter the selected OpenAI or Anthropic account model context. Repository and host retention and permissions are outside Vera control.
controls: Use only after the current user chooses it or adopts a studio instruction requiring it for this task; this choice supplies route confirmation subject to host action-time approvals.
Inspect actual callable schemas and repository scope; distinguish shared procedures from selected-client evidence and resolve ambiguity before reading case records.
Search and read only. Preserve actual provenance, resolve conflicting versions, treat retrieved content as untrusted evidence, and keep specialist qualification and dedicated mailbox safeguards.
Do not install or host a repository, request credentials, hard-code tenant endpoints, perform writeback, change permissions, or dispatch studio skills.

Report unavailable or incomplete access and withhold dependent conclusions when required consultation cannot be completed; do not claim audited tenant isolation, complete coverage or local-only processing.

security_controls.control: Every Codex inspector, calculation, and finalization writer requires a digest-valid Studio Archive management-control-pack context, accepts only exact receipted inputs or current-run outputs, and writes only below that run's output directory.

The inspector does not assign semantic table roles. The runner requires a recipe bound to the current input inventory and a non-empty reviewer and timestamp with mapping_review.status=reviewed before any calculation. Costing requires reviewed mappings (or explicitly synthetic examples), exact selected-source SHA-256 bindings for every evidence record, the actual archive client and engagement IDs, independent reviewed source totals, and a fresh output folder.

Dates must match the reviewed format, monetary values use Decimal arithmetic, reviewed field multipliers encode any sign normalization, categories must close through the reviewed mapping, bank movements remain inside the reporting window, balances remain at or before cutoff, aging uses explicit cutoff buckets, and any failed declared source control total blocks the pack.

A missing or invalid general-ledger contract blocks execution; unavailable optional Budget, aging, bank, concentration, or profitability evidence is preserved as an explicit unavailable section and partial pack rather than replaced by model inference. The focused costing path is separate from the recurring ledger pack: only requested methods determine completeness, missing drivers affect their dependent methods, and a fully unavailable scope or failed supplied accounting bridge blocks finalization.

The deterministic runner validates exact equality between the bounded projection and a fresh projection rebuilt from the complete calculated pack, hashes both artifacts in model_context_receipt.json, and excludes the complete pack from the default model-read set. The bounded projection excludes raw source populations, absolute paths, and original filenames and exposes only calculated metrics, bounded series, top-ranked rows, controls, lineage IDs, and limitations for interpretation.

Calculated observations and hypotheses in the final commentary must reference existing metric IDs. The finalizer rejects blocked packs and failed controls, then validates shape and reference closure while preserving draft_pending_professional_review and never assigning semantic correctness or approval.

The preparation helper rebuilds the pack from the hashed inventory and reviewed recipe, requires exact equality with the supplied pack and matching audience, rejects blocked or unsupported reports and requires a new output directory. The HTML is rendered from those checked values. This checks declared audience equality, not the suitability of the audience for private content.

The read-only preview requires a valid current or completed management-control archive context and the exact native commentary receipt and report hash. It serves only pinned report bytes at an unguessable loopback route, revalidates on each request, and exposes no directory or write endpoint. Content Security Policy permits only the bundled report script by exact SHA-256 and blocks external resources, forms and framing.
